adaptation: AGC ring and driver counter layout, DCE ioctl query, rolling/multipass interpretation and PS4 GNM entry-counter strategy. ProsperoMenu adds generation-bound guarded worker reads, per-page translation, explicit display-rate fallback, optional shared sampling and independent menu/metric sequences. The PS4 path adds a split RX/RW arena, enabled/cookie control block, stopped publication with rollback, and durable installation receipts. No cached physical mappings, old HEN marker files or sampling daemon are carried over.

sdk.use: Linked kernel_proc_getpaddr page translation; ProsperoMenu performs its own bounded physical reads. The generic process-copy fallback is not used by telemetry.
